gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1

This PR makes the importer reject records that have no id before anything is written, and adds the import-validation spec; you are its author. Rejecting a record without an id is covered by code, a test and the import docs, and the operator's confirmation of that rejection on staging is checked after merge, but nothing covers the spec's promise that the import error includes the line number.

One problem blocks merging: the spec requires the import error to include the line number, but the importer returns only the message and never computes a line. An operator importing a 500-line file would see "missing id" with no way to tell which record failed, and no test checks for a line number (src/importer.mjs:12, test/importer.test.mjs:8). The description also says the staging total will equal the total before deploy; that can only be seen after deploying, so this check cannot confirm it, and it does not block merging. After merge, the spec asks whoever merges to tag the release. No repository document names a command for that step, so it will be listed with that reason and not run.

I recommend deliver because this is your PR and the spec already says what the fix must do.

Pick one:
1. deliver - repair blockers, rebase on main, watch CI, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. assess - post the missing line number problem to the PR as a review and make no repairs.
3. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.
